integrity: The entire 65536-array binary domain was independently enumerated; the 8192 sign-normalized matrices were also checked via a separate Parseval convolution identity. The previously known scalar optimum is not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary 4-by-4 aperiodic aperture classification; scalar optimum 304 / merit 16/3 is known from Eggers as quoted in Schmidt. No complex-phase, larger-aperture or infinite-family claim. Older complete specialized texts remain priority risks.
title: Complete binary optimizer orbits of the \(4\times4\) square Fourier aperture
